MAX

A Broadblade awarded to Gladiators of exceptional merit. Its engravings draw inspiration from Griffrexes—natural-born hunters and the first allies Septimontians found in this land. Their bond needs no words, radiant and pure, like the blazing sun that watches over all.

Aureate Zenith is a Broadblade weapon in Wuthering Waves.
